column1: # Seconds each test of ./engines/vllm/vllmengine took under go test -race -count=1, recorded
# once on one machine (18 CPUs), for the tests that took at least a second. Only the ratios
# matter: scripts/ci-shard.sh (CI_SHARD_DURATIONS) deals these tests longest first onto
# vllm-race's five shards, and hashes every test not named here. A stale or missing line
# moves a test between shards, never out of the run. Re-record with:
#   go test -race -count=1 -json ./engines/vllm/vllmengine, keeping each top-level test's Elapsed
